maml:description.maml:para: Exports the AutoTask BaseURI, API, & JSON configuration information to file

The Export-AutoTaskModuleSettings cmdlet exports the AutoTask BaseURI, API, & JSON configuration information to file
Making use of PowerShell's System.Security.SecureString type, exporting module settings encrypts your API secret & integration code in a format that can only be unencrypted with the your Windows account as this encryption is tied to your user principal. This means that you cannot copy your configuration file to another computer or user account and expect it to work
On Linux & macOS the SecureString is NOT encrypted, it is recommended to use the AUTOTASK_BASE_URI, AUTOTASK_API_USERNAME, AUTOTASK_API_SECRET, & AUTOTASK_API_INTEGRATION_CODE environment variables or a secret store instead
Define the name of the AutoTask configuration file
By default the configuration file is named: config.psd1

By default the configuration file is stored in the following location: $env:USERPROFILE\Celerium.AutoTask
